note: Alberta Parks campground in Bow Valley Provincial Park, 12 km east of Canmore off Hwy 1 at Dead Man's Flats, run by Cedar & Spruce Campgrounds. Well-treed sites near the Bow River, with a hand launch for small non-motorized boats. The hand pump's water is not safe to drink or use; bring water. The nearest dump station is at Bow Valley Campground. --Claude
